Name: borough
Definition: Name of the Montreal borough, used to match and combine records across datasets.

Name: Total theft
Definition: Retained 2021 theft incidents.

Name: theft_acts_per_capita
Definition: Retained 2021 theft incidents divided by 2021 population.

Name: Total break_in
Definition: Retained 2021 break in incidents.

Name: break_in_acts_per_capita
Definition: Retained 2021 number of break in incidents divided by 2021 population.

Name: Total misdemeanor
Definition: Retained 2021 number of misdemeanor incidents.

Name: misdemeanor_acts_per_capita
Definition: Retained 2021 misdemeanor incidents divided by 2021 population.

Name: Total death
Definition: Retained 2021 deaths.

Name: death_acts_per_capita
Definition: Retained 2021 number of deaths divided by 2021 population

Name: total_area (ha)
Definition: borough area in square kilometres multiplied by 100.

Name: green_area (ha)
Definition: The total area, in hectares, of the selected parks managed by each borough

Name: green_area (%)

Name: num_children
Definition: 2021 population aged 0–14

Name: num_schools

Name: children_per_school
Definition: num_children / num_schools. Not actual enrolment, class size or capacity.

Name: median_monthly_shelter_cost_2br_cad
Source: Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements
Definition: Median monthly housing cost for renters in 2-bedroom homes in 2021, including applicable utilities.

Name: median_monthly_shelter_cost_3br_cad
Source: Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements
Definition: Median monthly housing cost for renters in 3-bedroom homes in 2021, including applicable utilities.

Name: assumed_monthly_household_income_cad
Definition: Monthly household income assumed in the project: $3,000.

Name: median_2br_cost_share_of_assumed_income_pct
Source: Calculated from Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements; Project assumptions
Definition: Percentage of the assumed $3,000 income needed to cover the median 2-bedroom housing cost.

Name: median_3br_cost_share_of_assumed_income_pct
Source: Calculated from Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements; Project assumptions
Definition: Percentage of the assumed $3,000 income needed to cover the median 3-bedroom housing cost.

Name: budget_2000_minus_median_2br_cad
Source: Calculated from Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements; Project assumptions
Definition: $2,000 budget minus the 2021 median 2-bedroom housing cost. Positive means the budget is higher than the cost.

Name: budget_3000_minus_median_2br_cad
Source: Calculated from Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements; Project assumptions
Definition: $3,000 budget minus the 2021 median 2-bedroom housing cost. Positive means the budget is higher than the cost.

Name: budget_2000_minus_median_3br_cad
Source: Calculated from Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements; Project assumptions
Definition: $2,000 budget minus the 2021 median 3-bedroom housing cost. Positive means the budget is higher than the cost.

Name: budget_3000_minus_median_3br_cad
Source: Calculated from Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements; Project assumptions
Definition: $3,000 budget minus the 2021 median 3-bedroom housing cost. Positive means the budget is higher than the cost.

Name: renter_households_2016
Source: Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements
Definition: Number of renter households in the borough in 2016.

Name: renter_households_2021
Source: Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements
Definition: Number of renter households in the borough in 2021.

Name: renter_household_growth_2016_2021_pct
Source: Calculated from Montréal household and housing profiles (2021 Census): https://donnees.montreal.ca/fr/dataset/profils-menages-logements
Definition: Percentage change in renter households from 2016 to 2021.
